sourceNote: 旧版提示词模板测试覆盖七类图片场景；本索引仅保存重新编写的可执行模板。

templates.title: 实拍换场景并保持商品不变
templates.description: 只替换商品周围环境，保留包装、比例、Logo、标签和材质，并匹配新场景光影。
templates.prompt: Edit the supplied product photograph. Replace only the surrounding scene with {{scene_description}}. Preserve the exact shape, proportions, packaging, logo, label text, material, perspective, and contact shadow. Do not redesign, relabel, duplicate, or obscure the product.

templates.title: 电商 Listing 全套商品图
templates.description: 为指定平台规划主图、尺寸图、多角度、场景图和材质细节，并保持商品身份一致。
templates.prompt: Create a {{platform}} listing image set for {{country}} in {{language}}. The product is {{product_name}}, with selling points {{selling_points}}. Include a clean main image, size diagram, multi-angle view, lifestyle scene, and material detail while preserving one consistent product identity.

templates.title: 结构化业务流程信息图
templates.description: 把主题拆成四个连接清晰的阶段，用短标题、图标和一句话说明组织信息。
templates.prompt: Create a professional editorial infographic explaining {{topic_title}}. Show four connected stages: {{stage1_name}}, {{stage2_name}}, {{stage3_name}}, and {{stage4_name}}. Use clear directional flow, short labels, restrained colors, readable typography, and no dense text blocks.

templates.title: 3D 悬浮黏土微缩岛屿
templates.description: 用哑光黏土材质、柔和漫反射和等轴测构图表现治愈的微缩场景。
templates.prompt: Whimsical 3D isometric floating clay island depicting {{island_theme}}. Use tactile matte materials, pastel earthy colors, gentle ambient occlusion, rounded organic geometry, a clean background, and a calm modern illustration aesthetic.

templates.title: 35mm 胶片电影叙事画面
templates.description: 用真实胶片颗粒、温润高光和未摆拍构图表达具有故事性的电影画面。
templates.prompt: Cinematic 35mm film still of {{scene_storyline}}. Use authentic fine grain, gentle highlight halation, atmospheric low light from {{ambient_light_source}}, an unposed documentary composition, and a restrained cinematic color grade.

templates.title: 赛博朋克霓虹雨夜街道
templates.description: 以湿润路面、青紫霓虹和蒸汽雾气构建具有电影感的未来都市街道。
templates.prompt: Futuristic cyberpunk street at rainy midnight. Wet asphalt reflects electric cyan and magenta neon, steam rises from street grates, distant towers fade into mist, and cinematic anamorphic light creates atmospheric depth without clutter.

templates.title: 高定杂志级商业人像
templates.description: 以柔和影棚光、真实皮肤纹理和明确服装细节呈现时尚杂志级人像。
templates.prompt: Editorial high-fashion portrait of {{subject_portrait}} wearing {{outfit_and_accessories}}. Use a large softbox and reflector, a direct expressive gaze, natural skin texture, crisp eyes, an elegant neutral backdrop, and an 85mm f/1.4 shallow depth of field.

templates.title: 概念大字排版艺术海报
templates.description: 围绕一个核心概念组织大字、留白和抽象视觉，适合海报草案与视觉方向探索。
templates.prompt: Create a conceptual poster about {{concept}} with the headline {{headline}}. Build a bold typographic hierarchy, generous negative space, one memorable abstract visual metaphor, a controlled {{color_palette}} palette, and accurate readable text.

templates.title: 纯白底商业产品精修
templates.description: 以纯白背景、居中构图和柔和接触阴影呈现清晰的商业产品主图。
templates.prompt: Professional commercial product photography of {{product_name}} centered on a seamless pure white background. Use precise soft studio lighting, a subtle contact shadow, crisp edges, accurate surface texture, and no color bleeding.

templates.title: 全方位多角度产品视图
templates.description: 用统一光线和背景展示正面、45 度和侧面视图，突出几何一致性。
templates.prompt: Create a cohesive studio showcase of {{product_item}} with synchronized front, 45-degree hero, and side views. Keep geometry, scale, color, controls, and material details consistent across every angle on a neutral background.

templates.title: 移动端 App 高保真界面
templates.description: 生成包含导航、核心卡片和数据模块的移动端界面，并保持文字层级清晰。
templates.prompt: Design a high-fidelity {{platform}} mobile app screen for {{app_type}} in {{theme_mode}} mode. Use the header {{header_title}}, show {{card_content}}, and emphasize {{primary_accent_color}}. Keep spacing, typography, icons, and component hierarchy production-ready.
